<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
The task is to schedule a 30-minute meeting for four partners.
In the previous session, I identified a suitable time (Thursday, 14:30-15:00) and communicated it to Alison.
Alison has now confirmed that she has booked the meeting.
My final task is to send the confirmation email to the partners.
I have all the necessary information to send the email: the day (Thursday), the start time (14:30), and the attendees (all four partners).
I will now use the `send_confirmation_email` function to complete my part of the task.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>

function.name: send_confirmation_email
function.arguments: {"body":"Dear Partners, this email confirms a 30-minute meeting for the four of you has been booked for Thursday, November 19, from 14:30 to 15:00 Eastern.","start":"14:30","day":"Thu"}
